'''Taym Dren-garen''' was a guard of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], spending [[time]] in the [[Hutt]]'s [[Boba Fett's Palace|Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[4 ABY]]. In the palace, Dren-garen witnessed Jabba feed the dancer [[Oola]] to his [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]] during a performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]] and was then present for the arrival of a disguised [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]].

When the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] arrived to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] Organa, Chewbacca, and the former [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], Dren-garen stood behind Jabba's throne as the Hutt tried to feed Skywalker to the rancor, and then sentenced Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca to death at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Dren-garen then accompanied Jabba to the pit on the crime lord's [[LO-KD57|sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]''. At the pit, the [[prisoner]]s freed themselves and Dren-garen was killed by Skywalker after shooting the Jedi in the [[Limb|hand]].

==Biography==
===Excitment at court===
[[File:Gargan-Laughing-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Taym Dren-garen watched as Oola was devoured by the rancor.]]
The [[Human]] Taym Dren-garen<ref name="Hasbro" /> served in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a guard.<ref name="Junior">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Dren-garen was present in the court room of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the Hutt and his court watched a performance of the [[Music|song]] "[[Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band]]. Dren-garen stood on the raised stage talking to a bald human during part of the performance, with Jabba demanding the song be repeated once it ended. As it was played for a second [[time]], the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> refused Jabba's advanced, and so the crime lord dropped the dancer into the pit beneath the throne room where he kept his pet [[rancor]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Pateesa]].<ref name="LifeDebt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref>

With the song coming to an abrupt end, Dren-garen was among the courtiers who rushed forward to a grating looking down into the pit so that they could watch as Oola was [[Death|devoured]]. As the excitement subsided, a commotion in the stairwell leading down to the court room drew the attention of the court, and Dren-garen and others wandered toward the door to see what was happening. The court member<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Doallyn]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> was thrown back down the stairs after approaching as [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] entered. Dren-garen and the others moved back to make room for the pair in front of the thrown, where Organa presented Chewbacca as her [[prisoner]] and demanded the [[bounty]] for the Wookiee from Jabba. During negotiations, she threatened the court with a [[thermal detonator]], causing many to cower, but ultimately came to an agreement with the Hutt, who had Chewbacca taken away as Dren-garen watched.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Unlucky shot===
Organa and Chewbacca had arrived at the palace as part of a [[Rescue of Han Solo|plot]] to rescue [[Han Solo]], a former [[smuggler]] who Jabba held prisoner in a block of [[carbonite]]. Organa freed Solo from the block later that night, but both were then captured by Jabba. While Jabba and his court later [[Sleep|slept]], Solo, Organa, and Chewbacca's ally, [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]], arrived at the palace. Skywalker entered the throne room to confront Jabba, and after the Hutt awoke, Dren-garen and the<ref name="ROTJ" /> guard [[Fozec]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> emerged to stand behind the crime lord's throne. Skywalker demanded the release of Solo, but after the [[Jedi]] threatened Jabba with a [[blaster]], he was dropped into the rancor pit. Dren-garen remained in place as others rushed forward to watch, although Skywalker slayed the rancor. The Jedi was then brought back up to the throne room alongside Solo and Chewbacca, and Dren-garen stood behind the Hutt as Jabba sentenced the prisoners to be executed at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], where they would be fed to the [[sarlacc]] that dwelt there.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Dren-garen was among the court members who accompanied Jabba to the pit on board the crime lord's [[LO-KD57|sail barge]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> the ''[[Khetanna]]''.<ref name="Geektionary" /> Once there, the court watched from the barge as the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] hovered over the pit, but before they could be pushed in, the prisoners freed themselves and fought back. After Organa killed Jabba, Skywalker boarded the ''Khetanna'' and began dispatching the guards on the top deck with his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]]. Dren-garen emerged from a hatch leading to the lower decks and fired at Skywalker, hitting the Jedi's [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] right [[Limb|hand]] and burning off the [[synthskin]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> As Skywalker's hand had [[sensor]]y wiring, the Jedi felt a stab of pain, but maintained his grip on his lightsaber<ref name="Junior" /> and then bravely counterattacked,<ref name="ROTJ AD">{{Film|VI}} {{C|[[Disney+]] audio description}}</ref> slashing Dren-garen with his [[lightsaber]] and killing the guard. Skywalker and his allies then destroyed the ''Khetanna'' and escaped from Tatooine.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Dren-garen had light skin.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Dren-garen wore a gray [[Clothing|shirt]] under a light brown tunic and a dark brown tabard, with brown [[boot]]s and a brown [[belt]]. The guard used a brown [[helmet]] with white antler-like decorations on the brow and a brown face covering. Dren-garenheld a [[spear]] while guarding Jabba's throne and used a [[DL-18 blaster pistol]] while on the ''Khetanna''.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taym Dren-garen appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The character was portrayed by stuntman [[Larry Holt]], who also portrayed [[Sergeant]] [[Bruckman]]<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=EmpireConLA|url=EmpireConLA/photos/larry-holt-is-joining-us-at-empire-con-and-making-his-first-convention-appearanc/1779049615530388/?locale=pl_PL|name=Los Angeles Empire Con|date=2019-04-19|quote=LARRY HOLT is joining us at Empire Con​ and making his first convention appearance! Larry played Taym Dren-garen and many other roles in Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi. Larry is an accomplished stuntman and actor and in addition to playing Dren-garen he also portrayed Sergeant Bruckman of the Rebellion strike team during the Battle of Endor.|archivedate=20230411111245}}</ref> and acted as [[Harrison Ford]]'s stunt double in the film.<ref name="ROTJ" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in the [[2023]] "Jabba's Court Denizens" action figure pack released as part of the [[Hasbro]] ''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]''.<ref name="Hasbro" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card for the [[Taym Dren-garen/Legends|character]] released as part of the [[1998]] "[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]" expansion to the [[Decipher]] ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Taym Dren-garen}}</ref>

In ''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'', an adaptation of ''Return of the Jedi'' written by [[Tom Angleberger]]<ref name="Beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> and published on [[September 22]], [[2015]],<ref name="Amazon-Hardcover">{{Disney|subdomain=books|url=book/beware-the-power-of-the-dark-side|text=Beware the Power of the Dark Side!}}</ref>, a [[Snivvian]] guard is erroneously described as shooting Skywalker's hand instead of Taym Dren-garen,<ref name="Beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> contradicting what is shown in the film.<ref name="ROTJ" /> In a section of [[Hong Jac Ga]]'s [[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]] posted on [[December 11]], 2015, Organa is depicted as shooting Dren-garen three times with a [[blaster rifle]] after the skiff guard shoots Skywalker's hand<ref name="Webtoon">[[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]]</ref>  instead of the Jedi deflecting a bolt back at Dren-garen as in the film.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Costume===
{{Quote|The stuntmen all preferred to wear a black Adidas deck shoe in their work, because it was the most stable footwear and would on the foot securely. I just came up with some uppers of a sandal boot-type design that could be riveted onto the Adidas shoe so that the guys were walking on what they were familiar with, but it was decorated.|John Schrader|<ref name="Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref>}}
The costumes of Taym Dren-garen and the other human guards at Jabba's Palace were designed to resemble "costume number 7," a guard disguise worn by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], an ally of Skywalker, Organa, Solo, and Chewbacca, who is working undercover in the Hutt's court. Each costume had to be different, but similar enough to Calrissian's that he would not stand out in a crowd. The variant worn by Taym Dren-garen was the most similar to Calrissian's costume and was labeled "Lando variation X" or "costume number 7X." The main difference between the two costumes was the helmet. Inspired by medieval helmets, the variation X helmet had a antler-like face guard similar to Calrissian's that could be lowered before entering combat in a fashion similar to a medieval knight. While Calrissian's costume had this face guard lowered, Dren-garen's helmet had it raised above the face throughout the film.<ref name="Costumes" />

The rest of the costume consisted of a baggy-sleeved "pirate shirt," a pair of patch-covered linen pants, and a linen-padded and -quilted tabard which was similar to items worn by various other guards at the palace. As the stuntmen playing the skiff guards preferred to wear black [[Wikipedia:Adidas|Adidas]] deck shoes while performing due to the footwear's stability, boot maker [[John Schrader]] created upper portions of leather wrapping with a sandal-like design that could be riveted onto the Adidas shoes. This allowed the stuntmen to use the footwear they were familiar with while still having it be decorated for the film.<ref name="Costumes" />
